senses: to grow, become great or important, promote, make powerful, praise, magnify, do great things

strongs.def: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
strongs.kjv: advance, boast, bring up, exceed, excellent, be(-come, do, give, make, wax), great(-er, come to... estate, [phrase] things), grow(up), increase, lift up, magnify(-ifical), be much set by, nourish (up), pass, promote, proudly (spoken), tower
strongs.from: a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare H1434 (גְּדִל)), i.e.
